git_branch.description: Manage branches: list all branches, show current branch, create a new branch, delete a branch, or rename a branch.

all.description: For list mode: show both local and remote branches.

force.description: Force the operation, bypassing safety checks.

limit.description: For list mode: cap the number of branches returned (applied at the git command). Use on repos with many branches.

anyOf.description: Commit reference: full/short hash, branch name, tag name, or relative ref (HEAD~1). Must not start with "-".

merged.description: For list mode: show only branches merged into HEAD (true) or specified commit (string).

newBranchName.description: New branch name for rename operation.

anyOf.description: Commit reference: full/short hash, branch name, tag name, or relative ref (HEAD~1). Must not start with "-".

noMerged.description: For list mode: show only branches not merged into HEAD (true) or specified commit (string).

path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to session working directory set via git_set_working_dir.

remote.description: For list mode: show only remote branches.

startPoint.description: Starting point (commit/branch) for new branch creation.
